Performance summary

Computed from each strategy's daily net-of-cost returns in the selected window. Sharpe and Sortino use a 2% risk-free rate (the engine's default). Sorted by Sharpe.

Growth of $100

Log scale, so equal vertical distances mean equal percentage moves. Each line starts at $100 on the first day of the window.

Trade explorer: when each strategy traded, and why

Pick a strategy. The heatmap shows what it held each week (blue = long, red = short; darker = bigger weight). Ticks above it mark trade days. Click the heatmap or a row in the list to see the indicator values behind the decision and the fills it produced. Scoped to the window selected at the top.
